translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Isaraele hameiginiru mo bayale helonaga Mosesehanda bi lahenego ogo
Ngode Datagaliwabenaga bi mana latagi haga Mosese ibuni homolene horo kaware dege ngelo howa ibugua Isaraele wali agaliru mo bayale helonaga bi lahalu hene.
Ibugua lalu,

content.text: Anduane Homogo ibu Hari Sainai howa ibini.
Ibugua ni tagira ibiradagua ibalu Idomo dindini ani ibini.
Hari Parana heagoria howa ni darali haradagua bialu ibugua ibunaga wali agali bu hearuni daba hai haya.
Dahuliyali daosini daga labenahe dewaore ibuni heba mandagi howa
ibunaga gi tigahayagi ira hungu ale datagi haya.
Anduane Homogo ibugua ibunaga wali agaliru gubalini ho haga ka.
Ibugua wali agali ibunaga karu mamage halu biamogo biaga.
Ani biagago iname ibu geha bulu paluwa
ibugua bia laradagua hale howa bialu holene nga.
Anduane Homogonaga Mana lowinigo Mosese i̱na tí langirugoni
iname hale howa talialu bialu holene nga.
Bi Mana ogoni galoneorego inanaga dindiha duniniore nga.
Isaraele hameigini mbira mbira bibahendebi tinaga agali haguane hearubi ti íbu ngoaiho heangi
Anduane Homogo ibu Isaraele wali agalinaga kini ho hene,

content: lalu lene.
Mosese ibugua Lubene hameigini hearu mitangi bialu lalu,

content.text: Lubene hameigini emene hangu ha kagonigo
ti biba halu homaiore nahelo hameledo,

content: lalu lene.
Ibugua Yuda hameigini hearu mitangi bialu lalu,

content.text: Anduane Homogo-o Yuda hameigini bu karume ina biamogo bia lowa í̠ olalu kagola
í̠na tinaga bi larago hale halu biamogo bibe.
Í̠na ti hameigini maru karu baba lone mandagi helo mo mogobu helabe.
Tinaga waitigiru baba wai bialu kagola
Anduane Homogo-o í̠nime ti hongo mialu biamogo bibe,

content: lalu lene.
Ibugua Libai hameigini hearu mitangi bialu lalu,

content.text: Anduane Homogo-o í̠naga hame ledego ege to̱le̱ kira mini Urimu Tumimula ogoni labome mo walia habe.
Í̠naga biabe biahaga agali bayale Libaiali karuha howa mo walia habe.
Masa dindini hearia í̠na ti ba handalu
iba Meriba bereagoriabi tigua nde mana tigabiore birabe hondole í̠nime ti ba handarigoni.
Í̠na tihondo bia larodagua bialu halimu larigoni bialu
í̠naga Habo Nalolene Bi lo wirigobi talialu bialu hayagoni.
Uruni tigua ti aba ai̱yarubi damenerubi waneiginirubi tinaga bi hale holene nira ale lowa
Anduane Homogo í̠naga bi hangu hale howa talialu bialu haga ka.
Tigua í̠naga Isaraele wali agalirume í̠naga Mana lowinigo talialu bialu helo biawai holebira.
Tigua í̠naga lomabu delaga dabu kagoria loma biniru bo delaga bulebira.
Anduane Homogo-o í̠nime Libai hameigini uruni hongo halu anda hama irigi helo mo hongo haabo habe.
Tigua biabe bialu karu hondowa turu ho habe.
Uruni tinaga waitigi bu karu bibahendeore bo hengedaga bibe.
Ti lone heyabe naheore helo bo hengedaga bibe,

content: lalu lene.
Mosese ibugua Beniyamini hameigini hearu mitangi bialu lalu,

content.text: Anduane Homogo ibunime Beniyamini hameiginiore ti gubalini howa handayaho haabo haga.
Ibugua horo bibahendengi ti mamage haabo haga.
Ibugua horo mbirubi yu wanahe ti baba mandagi haaboore haga kagoni,

content: lalu lene.
Ibugua Yosebe hameigini hearu mitangi bialu lalu,

content.text: Anduane Homogo ibugua Yosebe hameiginirunaga dindi mo gumbila halu iba dalu bayale ibilaabo helo.
Dindiha howabi iba bayale duguaraga halu berelo hameledo.
Tinaga mabu hengedaruha mo gumbila halu ni daragome ira lini ibiralu do ndigindugu lalu
tinaga tomo uruni bibahende bayaleore boga biaiore helobi hameledo.
Dindi bare hombene ala wini ngaruha tinaga tomo hangararu bayaleore anda hai helo hameledo.
Tinaga dindiha Anduane Homogohanda mo gumbila halu
tomo bayale damene anda hai helo hameledo.
Anduane Homogo abale ira hungu deagoha howa i̱hondo bi lenego
ogoni ibugua ani bilo hameledo.
Bayale holene uruni Yosebe hameigininaga íbu wilo.
Yosebe ibu ibuni hamenerunaga haguane hayagome bayale turubi ani wilo.
Yosebe hameiginiru ti nogo bulumaga wangabe hongohe kagobi ka.
Bulumaga gabua haguaneni ne gayane kirahe kaligobi ka.
Ibunaga ne gayane mendego Manase hamewaneigini daosini dewaore karubi ka.
Mendego Eberaimi hamewaneigini aria daosini dewaore karubi ka.
Ne gayane kira ogoni labome dindi tara tarani hameigini palima pedaru bo he̱la amu haga biaga.
Ti dindi gibuni ngaruha bope laga bima piaga ka,

content: lalu lene.
Mosese ibugua Sebulunu Isagala hameigini hearu mitangi bialu lalu,

content.text: Sebulunu hameigini tigua solowara domalu dindi tara taraha pialu biyinaya bialu karia bayale helo.
Isaga hameigini tigua tini dindini howa biyinaga bialu karia bayale halu timbu dege helo hameledo.
Hameigini kira ogoni labome libuni dalu hari nene ngaruha wali agali tara tara karu bibahende íbu ngoai hadaba laga.
Mo ngoai howa loma biniru damene bibahende bayale tigabiore bulene ngadagua bialu bo miaga ka.
Tigua wali agali tara tara karu baba biyinaya bialu
iba solowaraha winiru mialubi
iba angeni ibamu bu ngaruha wini ngaru mialubi
urunime mbirale mo yu anda ibirarume tini homogo gibiore haga ka,

content: lalu lene.
Mosesehanda Gada hameigini hearu mitangi bialu lalu,

content.text: Ngode Datagaliwabe ibugua tinaga dindi henge timbuni mo yangala hayagonaga ibu mini yaraga holene nga.
Gada hameiginiore laiono hongohe kaligobi howa mbirale bo nole nendebu biruwa
gi ge bo dogalu haguaneni iri karu abale dogaralidagua ani biaga ka.
Isaraele hameigini dindi tu wu tahole íbu ngoai hayangi
Gada hameigini ti dindi bayale wiago tu wu mini.
Dindi ogoni agali haguanerume habehe wiago ti hene.
Isaraele agali haguaneru mandagi íbu ngoai howa
tigua Anduane Homogonaga mana lowini ngarubi hale halu talialu bialu hene,

content: lalu lene.
Ibugua Dana hameigini hearu mitangi bialu lalu,

content.text: Dana hameiginiru ti laiono hungubalua ale howa
Basana dindiha howa abaleore porabu tagi halu ibinigo ka,

content: lalu lene.
Mosesehanda Nabadali hameigini hearu mitangi bialu lalu,

content.text: Anduane Homogohanda mbirale bibahende bayale damenego Nabadali hameiginiru mialu
ti homogo gibiore ho ka.
Tinaga dindi tubaria Galili iba kuyama bedago bolangua halu unura puabo ka,

content: lalu lene.
Ibugua Ase hameigini hearu mitangi bialu lalu,

content.text: Anduane Homogohanda hameigini maru karu mo turu hayadagua ndo
Ase hameigini tiore bolangua howa mo turu hene ka.
Isaraele hameigini maru bu karume Ase hameiginiru baba howa tini miniha turu hagabu helo.
Ti daluha ira olibe dewaore anda haga biragola tinaga olibe lininaga ibane timbuni biru wilo hameledo.
Tinaga tanoruha wai pabe hongoheore egeme bianda howa pabe pangaru aeaneme wabu helelo.
Waitigiru tano ogoniha anda naibabeheda lowa ti gi nahe embedaho helo hameledo,

content: lalu lene.
Ani lowa Mosesehanda ti bibahendehondo lamialu lalu,

content.text: Isaraele wali agaliru-o inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kagobi mende naheore.
Ibugua hari daligani wá holene heba ibalu
hari beralibaha howa ina biamogo bule ibaga kagoni.
Ngode Datagaliwabe haluhe kago ibu inanaga ha do hagane andaore henego haabo ka.
Ibu andaneha howa ibunaga gini ina maliaho haabo kamagoni.
Tínaga dindi biago karulole anda pialu pirimingi ibugua bamba halu tínaga waitigi bu hearuni bo batagi halu
uruni tínime bo wahai hadaba lalu langiyagoni.
Ani binigo nde Yagaba aguaneneru ti hado payabu karia mbiralime wai bima lole mbira naibaga.
Hari daligaha howa dalu emene ibaabo haga ngagome dindi mo gomba haga.
Dindi ogoniha tomo widirubi waini ibabi dewaore wirago
tigua turu howa baya hangu mo wialu haga ka.
Isaraeleru-o tí turu timbuniore holene nga.
Anduane Homogohanda tí biamogo bialu haru dai biniorego kami.
Hameigini mende mbira ani binigo nahe.
Anduane Homogo ibuniore tínaga wai humbibi ayu tibu nene gadele alebi kagoni.
Ibugua tí ho pabebu howa wai beramingi ibunime tí mo wayali helaga ka.
Tínaga waitigi bu karume tí kamiria ibuwa dugu bialu ina dara howa biamogo bidaba lolebira.
Tígua waitigi uruni bope halu hengedoleberemi,

content: lalu Mosesehanda lamaro bini.

footnotes.text: 33.8 Urimu Tumimu bi ogolabo irane mbuga Haru Tagira Penego 28.30 handabe.
